controls.name: always-overlap and always-non-overlap diagnostics
controls.role: Required degenerate detection controls that expose metric behavior; they are not product candidates and were not run on a valid overlap cohort.

controls.name: speaker-level truth versus any-speaker union
controls.role: Both representations must be preserved; a union-only score cannot establish per-speaker overlap or active-speaker count.

controls.name: unknown-region masking
controls.role: Unannotated time is excluded, never relabelled nonspeech or non-overlap.

controls.name: zero, one and multiple active-speaker strata
controls.role: Count error must be reported by stratum including silence, single speaker, two speakers and three or more; aggregate accuracy alone hides counting failure.

controls.name: identity / passthrough audio
controls.role: Detection and counting never modify PCM; an identity control guards against a gate or separation being credited as detection.

controls.name: calibrated array geometry and synchronized channels
controls.role: Spatial statistics require a declared array, channel alignment and reference; mono activity evidence cannot validate a spatial overlap detector.

controls.name: synthetic mixture versus natural overlap
controls.role: Constructed additive turns test robustness but do not substitute for naturally simultaneous speech, speaker overlap or count truth.

controls.name: any-speech VAD activity control
controls.role: A speech-activity detector is a baseline for onset/offset behavior, not an overlap detector or speaker counter.

controls.name: missing, invalid, nonfinite and out-of-range interval rejection
controls.role: Missing or malformed intervals are blocked, not scored; no missing result may qualify a candidate or produce a count.
